name: congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 deficiency
description: Congenital plasminogen activator inhibitor type 1 (PAI-1) deficiency is a rare genetic bleeding disorder characterized by premature lysis of hemostatic clots and a moderate bleeding tendency.
